columns.crypto_template|analyticsindicators|mdat: Integer key linking to market data source. Unique values per row, roughly 1 to 1000. No nulls.
columns.crypto_template|analyticsindicators|msta: Integer key linking to market statistics source. Unique values per row, roughly 1 to 1000. No nulls.

columns.crypto_template|systemmonitoring|systemm: Integer value from 1 to 999, with 1000 distinct values in the profile. Serves as a unique row or pivot identifier in monitoring data. Values are numeric and contain no nulls.
columns.crypto_template|systemmonitoring|apireqt: Integer count of API requests, values range from 1001 to 9988, with 960 distinct values. Duplicates are sparse. Values are numeric and contain no nulls.
columns.crypto_template|systemmonitoring|apierrt: Integer count of API errors, values range from 0 to 99, with 101 distinct values. Common values are between 10 and 98. Values are numeric and contain no nulls.
columns.crypto_template|systemmonitoring|apilatm: Integer value from 1 to 999, with 636 distinct values. Represents a latency measurement or marker rather than a raw duration. Values are numeric and contain no nulls.
columns.crypto_template|systemmonitoring|wsstate: Text field with two distinct values: 'Connected' and 'Disconnected'. Value lengths are 9 and 12 characters respectively. No nulls.
columns.crypto_template|systemmonitoring|raterem: Integer value from 0 to 999, with 620 distinct values. Represents the amount of rate allowance remaining; lower values indicate less allowance left. Values are numeric and contain no nulls.
columns.crypto_template|systemmonitoring|lastupd: Text value always 7 characters long, unique across rows, with values ranging from '1024395' to '9988341'. Although named note, the values look like numeric identifiers. No nulls.
columns.crypto_template|systemmonitoring|seqcode: Text value always 7 characters long, unique across rows, with values ranging from '1006368' to '9999688'. Looks like a numeric sequence code. No nulls.
columns.crypto_template|systemmonitoring|sliprat: Real number from -0.001 to 0.01, with 21 distinct values and up to 3 decimal places. Can be negative, zero, or positive. No nulls.
columns.crypto_template|systemmonitoring|exectim: Real number from 10.0 to 999.0, with one decimal place and 624 distinct values. Represents elapsed execution time in some unit. No nulls.
columns.crypto_template|systemmonitoring|queueli: Integer value from 10 to 999, with 655 distinct values. Represents a position or count in a queue. Values are numeric and contain no nulls.
columns.crypto_template|systemmonitoring|mkteffe: Numeric value roughly from -0.0001 to 0.01, with 199 distinct values, often expressed with four decimal places. Can be negative. No nulls.
columns.crypto_template|systemmonitoring|priceef: Numeric value from 0 to 0.01, with 101 distinct values and up to four decimal places. Measures price impact. No nulls.
columns.crypto_template|systemmonitoring|aitrack: Integer value from 1 to 999, unique across rows in the profile. Appears to be a sequential tracking number for AI-related monitoring entries. Values are numeric and contain no nulls.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|marketstatsm: Integer ID for each market stats row. Values roughly 1-1000; one per row.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|fundrate: Signed decimal funding rate. Values mostly between -0.001 and 0.001. Negative and positive values both appear.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|fundspot: Timestamp in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format. Fixed 19 characters; hourly snapshots on same date.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|openstake: Numeric open stake value. Values around 100k to 1M; decimal values with one or two decimal places.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|volday: Numeric value for total volume in a day. Values around 1M to 10M; some decimal places despite integer type.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|tradeday: Integer count of trades during a day. Values between about 10k and 100k.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|tnoverday: Numeric daily turnover value. Values around 1M to 10M; similar scale to volday.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|priceshiftda: Signed fractional price change for a day. Values from -0.001 to 0.2. Negative means decline, positive means rise.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|highspotday: Highest spot price observed in a day. Values vary widely, commonly tens of thousands.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|lowspotday: Lowest spot price observed in a day. Values vary widely, commonly tens of thousands.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|vwapday: VWAP for a day, decimal price. Values commonly tens of thousands.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|mktsize: Numeric total market capitalization. Values around 100M to 1B.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|circtotal: Numeric circulating supply amount. Values around 10M to 100M.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|totsupply: Numeric total supply amount. Values around 100M to 200M.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|maxsupply: Numeric maximum supply cap. Values around 100M to 350M.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|mkthold: Decimal ratio between 0 and 0.5. Fractional holding measure.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|traderank: Numeric rank from 1 to 99. Lower number means higher activity.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|liquidscore: Decimal score from 0 to 1 measuring liquidity. Higher score means more liquid.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|volmeter: Numeric volume indicator, range 0.24 to 99.98. Higher value means stronger volume.
columns.crypto_template|marketstats|mdlink: Integer ID linking to market data entity. Unique per row, roughly 1-1000.
columns.crypto_template|orderexecutions|orderexe: Stores a distinct integer identifier from 1 to 999 for each order execution record. Values are positive integers, no nulls, with length patterns from single digits to four digits.
columns.crypto_template|orderexecutions|fillcoun: Stores the filled quantity as a positive real number between 0.0 and 9.8168. Values have up to four decimal places, patterns D.D to D.DDDD, with no nulls.
columns.crypto_template|orderexecutions|remainco: Stores the remaining quantity as a positive real number between 0.0011 and 9.4193. Values have up to four decimal places, patterns D.DD to D.DDDD, with no nulls.
columns.crypto_template|orderexecutions|fillquot: Stores a quote value associated with an execution, ranging from 998.69 to 52271.62. Values have one or two decimal places, patterns DDD.DD to DDDDD.DD, with no nulls.
columns.crypto_template|orderexecutions|fillsum: Stores a monetary or quantity sum related to fills, with positive values starting at 0.02 and ranging into hundreds of thousands, e.g., 421974.66. Values have one or two decimal places, patterns DDD.DD to DDDDDD.DD, with no nulls.
columns.crypto_template|orderexecutions|expiresp: Stores an expiration timestamp as text with date, time, and fractional seconds. Values are 24 to 26 characters, format DDDD-DD-DD DD:DD:DD.DDDDDD, with fractional seconds of four to six digits, no nulls.
columns.crypto_template|orderexecutions|cancelno: Stores a short cancellation note as one of three strings: Expired, InsufficientFunds, or UserRequested. Contains NULL in about 24% of records; non-null values are 7 to 17 characters and alphabetic.
columns.crypto_template|orderexecutions|exectune: Stores the execution type as 'Maker' or 'Taker', always 5 characters. Contains NULL for about 31% of records; non-null values are exclusively Maker or Taker.
columns.crypto_template|orderexecutions|ordersma: Stores a unique order marker as 'OB' plus a six-digit number, right-padded with spaces to 36 characters. Nearly all values are distinct, no nulls, pattern AADDDDDD followed by spaces.
columns.crypto_template|fees|feesnode: Unique numeric fee node identifier. Values range 1-999, one per row, no nulls.
columns.crypto_template|fees|feerange: Categorical fee tier label from Tier1 to Tier4, always exactly 5 characters. Each tier appears roughly equally across rows.
columns.crypto_template|fees|feerate: Fee rate value in decimal form, ranging 0.0001 to 0.002. Values follow D.DDDD or D.DDD patterns; 20 distinct rates reused across nodes.
columns.crypto_template|fees|feetotal: Computed total fee as a decimal, ranging 0.003536 to 99.904706. Values are mostly unique, with lengths from 5 to 10 characters.
columns.crypto_template|fees|feecoin: Currency code for fee amounts; one of three tickers: USD, USDT, USDC. Codes are 3 or 4 characters, roughly evenly distributed.
columns.crypto_template|fees|rebrate: Rebate rate as decimal, ranging 0.0 to 0.001. Includes granular values like 0.0001 to 0.0009 plus zero; 11 distinct rates.
columns.crypto_template|fees|rebtotal: Total rebate amount as decimal, ranging 0.0 to 99.675945. Many distinct values; 52 rows have zero rebate.
columns.crypto_template|fees|orderslink: Reference to an order or order block. Format is OB followed by six digits, then trailing spaces to reach 36 characters. Nearly all values are unique.
columns.crypto_template|riskandmargin|riskandmar: Non-null integer values ranging 1-999. Values are unique per record in sample.
columns.crypto_template|riskandmargin|ordervault: Text of 36 chars. Format: 'OB' followed by 6 digits, right-padded with spaces. Non-null, mostly unique.

columns.crypto_template|users|usersnode: Integer user node identifier, range 1-999, unique per user, no nulls. Values are numeric with lengths 1-4 digits.
columns.crypto_template|users|userstamp: 36-character user identifier. Format is uppercase 'U' followed by 6 digits, right-padded with spaces to 36 characters, e.g. 'U100135                             '.
columns.crypto_template|users|acctscope: One of 4 values: 'Spot', 'Futures', 'Options', 'Margin'. Indicates the account type or trading scope.
columns.crypto_template|accountbalances|accountb: Integer node id from 1 to 999. Each row has a unique id; values are plain digits with no sign or leading zeros.
columns.crypto_template|accountbalances|walletsu: Positive real amount in decimal notation. Values have 1-2 digits after decimal point and range from about 100,404.41 to 999,952.78.
columns.crypto_template|accountbalances|availsum: Positive real amount in decimal notation. Values are unique and appear with 1-2 decimal digits; lengths range from 5 to 9 characters.
columns.crypto_template|accountbalances|frozensu: Positive real amount in decimal notation. Values are unique, have 1-2 decimal digits, and appear as monetary sums.
columns.crypto_template|accountbalances|margsum: Positive real amount in decimal notation. Values range from about 100,600.34 to 999,451.16, with 1-2 decimal digits.
columns.crypto_template|accountbalances|unrealli: Signed numeric value with decimal places. Values can be negative and range roughly from -10,012.72 to 99,772.21.
columns.crypto_template|accountbalances|realline: Signed numeric value with decimal places. Values can be negative and range roughly from -10,251.85 to 99,925.71.
columns.crypto_template|accountbalances|usertag: Fixed 36-character text string. Format is letter U, six digits, then trailing spaces; all values are unique.
columns.crypto_template|marketdata|marketdatanod: Integer from 1 to 999, all distinct across 1000 records. No nulls. Identifies a market data node in sequential form.
columns.crypto_template|marketdata|quote_depth_s: Structured JSON text, 365-379 chars. Nested objects: depth, quotes, spread, metadata. Contains numeric prices/units, exchange code, market pair, timestamp.
Integer field inside depth object. Number of ask price levels in snapshot. Values range 1 to 1000, repeats common.
Numeric field inside depth object. Ask side units available, formatted with 2-4 decimal places, values mostly 4-7 chars.
Integer field inside depth object. Number of bid price levels in snapshot. Values range 1 to 1000, repeats common.
Numeric field inside depth object. Bid side units available, formatted with 2-4 decimal places, values mostly 4-7 chars.
Numeric field inside quotes object. Ask price value, formatted with 1-2 decimal places, values mostly 5-8 chars.
Numeric field inside quotes object. Bid price value, formatted with 1-2 decimal places, values mostly 5-8 chars.
Numeric field inside quotes object. Midpoint between bid and ask, formatted with 1-2 decimal places, values mostly 5-8 chars.
Numeric field inside quotes object. Mark price value, formatted with 1-2 decimal places, values mostly 5-8 chars.
Numeric field inside quotes object. Index price value, formatted with 1-2 decimal places, values mostly 5-8 chars.
Numeric field inside spread object. Spread width, formatted with 1-2 decimal places, values 1-5 chars.
Numeric field inside spread object. Relative spread measure, formatted with 2-4 decimal places, values 3-6 chars.
String field inside metadata. Format AADDD followed by trailing spaces, e.g. EX809     . 605 distinct exchange codes.
String field inside metadata. Market combo name, 7-8 chars, base-quote pair, 12 distinct pairs like ADA-USD, SOL-USDT.
String field inside metadata. UTC timestamp format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.microseconds, range 2025-02-19T08:29:46.049442 to .132317.
columns.crypto_template|orders|orderspivot: Column contains integers ranging from 1 to 999, with 999 distinct values and no nulls. Values appear sequential and each occurs once. Length varies from 1 to 4 characters.
columns.crypto_template|orders|recordvault: Values are always 36 characters, consisting of uppercase 'OB' followed by six digits and trailing spaces to fill the width. There are 999 distinct values, each unique. Pattern is AADDDDDD followed by spaces.
columns.crypto_template|orders|timecode: Contains timestamp strings like '2025-02-19 08:29:46.049442' with lengths from 24 to 26 characters due to varying fraction digits. There are 54 distinct timestamps, many repeated. Pattern is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff.
columns.crypto_template|orders|exchspot: Values are always 10 characters, starting with 'EX' followed by three digits and trailing spaces. 605 distinct values among 999 records. Pattern is AADDD followed by spaces.
columns.crypto_template|orders|mktnote: Contains market notations as three-letter base and three-letter quote separated by hyphen, lengths 7 or 8 characters. 12 distinct values, e.g., 'ADA-USDC', 'SOL-USDT'. Pattern AAA-AAA or AAA-AAAA.
columns.crypto_template|orders|orderstamp: Values are always 36 characters, starting with 'OR' followed by seven digits and trailing spaces. All 999 values are distinct. Pattern AADDDDDDD followed by spaces.
columns.crypto_template|orders|userlink: Values are always 36 characters, starting with 'U' followed by six digits and trailing spaces. Each of the 999 values is unique. Pattern ADDDDDD followed by spaces.
columns.crypto_template|orders|ordertune: Contains four distinct text values: 'Stop' (258), 'StopLimit' (255), 'Limit' (246), 'Market' (240). Lengths range from 4 to 9 characters. No nulls.
columns.crypto_template|orders|dealedge: Contains exactly two distinct values: 'Sell' (521 occurrences) and 'Buy' (478). Lengths are 3 or 4 characters.
columns.crypto_template|orders|dealquote: Contains real numbers with up to two decimal places, e.g., 1000.12 to 9914.81 per profile (though some values exceed this range). 999 distinct values, no nulls. Patterns include DDDDD.DD, DDDD.DD.
columns.crypto_template|orders|dealcount: Values range from 0.0073 to 9.9825, with 996 distinct values. Patterns include D.DDDD, D.DDD, D.DD. No nulls.
columns.crypto_template|orders|notionsum: Values are large decimal numbers, with pattern DDDDDD.DD or DDDDD.DD. Profile lists min 100054.87 and max 99384.81 (inconsistent), but all values are positive. 999 distinct values.
columns.crypto_template|orders|orderflow: Contains four distinct values: 'Cancelled' (266), 'Filled' (248), 'PartiallyFilled' (246), 'New' (239). Lengths from 3 to 15 characters.
columns.crypto_template|orders|timespan: Always 3-character uppercase strings. Four distinct values: 'GTD' (268), 'FOK' (260), 'IOC' (236), 'GTC' (235).
columns.crypto_template|orders|orderbase: Contains four distinct text values: 'Web' (269), 'Mobile' (250), 'Bot' (246), 'API' (234). Lengths range from 3 to 6 characters.
columns.crypto_template|orders|clientmark: Values are always 9 characters, pattern AADDDDDDD. Each of the 999 values is unique, e.g., 'CL1006225'.
columns.crypto_template|orders|createspot: Contains timestamp strings like '2025-02-18 08:32:36.110719'. Lengths from 24 to 26 characters. 999 distinct values, each unique. Pattern YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff.
columns.crypto_template|orders|updatespot: Contains timestamp strings similar to timecode, with 54 distinct values. Values range from '2025-02-19 08:29:46.049442' to '2025-02-19 08:29:46.132317'. Lengths vary from 24 to 26 characters.
